turns.prompt: Fit the nonlinear model y = b1*b2*x*((1+b2*x)**(-1)) to the data in misra1d.csv (columns x, y) by least squares, starting from b1 = 500, b2 = 0.0001. Report every parameter (b1, b2) to at least 6 significant digits and the residual sum of squares as rss.

provenance: NIST StRD Misra1d (public domain), data copied verbatim
